Abaffe wali ofunye okunyumizibwa ku kibuutikira (eky’olunaku lw'enkomerero)?
Olunaku olwo ebyenyi bigenda kuba nga biswavu.
Abantu abo tebagenda kubeera na kyakulya kyonna okuggyako emiti egy'amaggwa.
Ebyenyi ebirala bigenda kubeera mu byengera.
Togenda kuwulira mu yo bigambo bya butaliimu.
Abaffe tebatunuulira (olutunuulira olw’okuyiga) eŋŋamiya ngeri ki bwe yatondebwa?
Kale nno jjukiza owange ggwe (Nnabbi Muhammadi) kubanga oli mujjukiza.
Naye oyo anaava ku bigambo byo n'ajeema.
Allah ajja kumubonereza ebibonerezo ebisinga okuba ebikakali.
Mazima ddala Gyetuli y’eri obuddo bwabwe.
Oluvanyuma mazima ddala okubalibwa kwabwe kuli ku Ffe.
